rows.label: tlk70000043_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Phew... Another day of
overfilling my belly.

rows.label: tlk70000043_01_msg0002
rows.name:
But not yet! It's still not enough!
Iiran cuisine has far more delicacy
and boldness than this!!

rows.label: tlk70000043_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Until I get to savor a legendary
dish from that famous chef,
my trip cannot be over!

rows.label: tlk70000043_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I came all the way from Superbia so
this tongue could taste the legend!

rows.label: tlk70000043_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Even if I run out of travel money, I'm
going to eat Kozel's cooking!
